an5.214:1.3: musā bhaṇati pisuṇaṃ bhaṇati pharusaṃ bhaṇati samphappalāpaṃ bhaṇati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati
an5.214:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā bahubhāṇismiṃ puggale.
an5.214:2.3: na musā bhaṇati na pisuṇaṃ bhaṇati na pharusaṃ bhaṇati na samphappalāpaṃ bhaṇati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati
an5.214:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā mantabhāṇismiṃ puggaleti.
